fusions.name: Bark-Still Lunge
fusions.desc: After holding still, you lunge at a target at or below 25% of its health, dealing 22 damage, up to 1.3 times that from further away. Its reach is 30% longer.

fusions.name: Stored Sunlight
fusions.desc: Releases the sunlight your leaves have stored, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Basking Bark
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Leaves Turned Sunward
fusions.desc: By day, your damage rises by 12%.
